blocksView.once: Shown once, then remembered per account.

gallery.replaceHint: Removes everything already on the canvas.

portTypes.designInputs: one per input the design declares

everyone.label: Everyone
everyone.description: True of every arrival. Wire it straight into a greeting to show that greeting to everybody - the simplest rule there is.

country.label: Country
country.description: True when the member connects from one of the picked countries.

tenure.label: On server since
tenure.description: Compares how long the account has existed on this server.

clientVersion.label: Client version
clientVersion.description: Matches the Mumble version the client announces.

fancyVersion.label: Fancy version
fancyVersion.description: Matches the fork's own version - or any build of it, which stock Mumble never is.

account.label: Account
account.description: True for a specific registered user or certificate.

group.label: Group
group.description: True when the member belongs to an ACL group.

os.label: OS
os.description: Matches the operating system reported by the client.

gates.and: True when both inputs are true.
gates.or: True when either input is true.
gates.xor: True when exactly one input is true.
gates.nand: True unless both inputs are true.
gates.nor: True when neither input is true.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Settles an undecided answer into a plain yes or no, so a gate can use it.

text.label: Reusable text
text.description: One line of prose, appended to a greeting and to every other greeting that wires it in.

textRich.label: Reusable text, formatted
textRich.description: The same snippet with a WYSIWYG editor on it: headings, lists, colour. For house rules rather than for one sentence.

greeting.label: Show this greeting
greeting.description: The message itself: what it says, and the condition that decides who reads it.

greetingRich.label: Show this greeting, formatted
greetingRich.description: The greeting written the way it will be read: a heading, a paragraph, a list. Wired exactly like the plain one.

greetingScreen.label: Welcome screen
greetingScreen.description: A greeting built from bands - a hero, a button, a row of links - which each client draws in its own type scale.

greetingDesign.label: Design block
greetingDesign.description: A greeting laid out in the design editor: blocks placed on a sheet, with named text slots and on/off conditions wired in from the canvas.

greetingLegacy.label: Welcome screen for Classic Mumble
greetingLegacy.description: The same bands compiled for Qt: tables, inline colour, no rounded corners. Wire it behind a client version condition; the modern one collapses on those clients.

nodes.undecided: May be undecided — wire it through a FILTER to settle it

problems.noGreeting: No greeting node - add one to say what people see.
problems.emptyScreen: The welcome screen has no bands with anything in them.
problems.badLink: A link on the welcome screen is not http:// or https://: {{url}}
problems.notWired: Nothing is wired to WHEN, so the greeting would never show.
problems.noCountries: A country node names no countries.
problems.noGroup: A group node names no group.
problems.emptySnippet: A reusable text node is empty.

views.classicHint: The same bands, compiled for the original Mumble client - 1.5 and older
views.classicNote: Compiled for Qt: tables, inline colour, no rounded corners. Wire it behind a client version condition so only the old clients get it.
views.lossy: This markup uses tags the editor cannot hold without rewriting them - tables, most likely. Editing it here as HTML keeps it exactly as it is.

header.label: Header strip
header.hint: A small line across the top: the server, a version.

hero.label: Hero
hero.hint: The badge, the big title, and the line under it.

image.label: Server artwork
image.hint: This server's own icon or banner, from its livery.

prose.label: Paragraph
prose.hint: Formatted text, written the way every other body is.

action.label: Button
action.hint: One thing to do, with a caption under it.

cards.label: Link row
cards.hint: Small cards side by side, each pointing somewhere.

screen.noBands: A screen with no bands shows nothing. Start with a hero.
screen.title: the line people read
screen.webOnly: Only http:// and https:// links are sent.
screen.subtitle: the second line

picture.noRoom: No room: {{room}} left, and this will not go under it.
picture.unreadable: That file is not a picture this can read.
picture.drop: Drop a picture, or click to choose
picture.room: {{room}} of room · sent to Fancy clients only

preview.heading: PREVIEW · WHAT THEY SEE
preview.unwired: nothing is wired to WHEN — shown to nobody
preview.legacy: Drawn as Mumble 1.5 and older will: tables, inline colour, square corners. Their rich text is a subset of HTML 4, so this is close to what Qt renders rather than to this client.
preview.htmlOff: This server has allow_html switched off, so it sends the plain half of every greeting. The formatting is kept, and starts being sent the moment the setting is on.
preview.unmatchable: No visitor can match this condition, so this greeting shows to nobody.
preview.shadowed: This greeting shows to nobody: every visitor it matches is taken by a greeting the server reaches first. Drag it above that one, or narrow the other's condition.
preview.overlap: Overlaps with the greeting before it — {{visitor}} matches both, and the earlier one wins. Deliberate if this is the general case behind a specific one.
preview.undecided: Too many combinations of conditions to check whether the greetings overlap.

placeholders.title: Section
placeholders.note: What this part of the graph is for, and why it is drawn this way.
placeholders.label: label

warm-welcome.label: Warm welcome, with the rules
warm-welcome.description: A formatted greeting for anyone who has just joined, plus the house rules as a reusable snippet you can wire into later greetings too.
warm-welcome.shows: Shown to accounts less than a week old.

quiet-welcome.label: One short line
quiet-welcome.description: The smallest greeting worth sending: a sentence, no heading, shown once. Start here when the formatted ones feel like too much.
quiet-welcome.shows: Shown to accounts less than a month old.

german-welcome.label: German-speaking welcome
german-welcome.description: A greeting in German for people connecting from DE, AT or CH. The pattern to copy for any other language: change the countries, change the words.
german-welcome.shows: Shown when the country is DE, AT or CH - and to nobody whose country the server cannot determine.

guest-nudge.label: Nudge guests to register
guest-nudge.description: For people connecting without an account: what registering gets them, and who to ask. Shown once, so it is not a monthly reminder.

outdated-client.label: Ask outdated clients to update
outdated-client.description: For anyone on a client older than 1.5: what will not work, and that updating is quick. The filter is set to warn on a maybe rather than stay quiet.
outdated-client.shows: Shown when the client is older than 1.5.0, including when the server cannot tell.

event-night.label: Announce a regular night
event-night.description: A centred announcement with the time and where to turn up, shown on every connect rather than once - which is what an announcement is for.
event-night.shows: Shown to registered members, on every connect.

designed-modern.label: A modern welcome
designed-modern.description: The one to start from: a display line set large and tight on the left, a small tinted badge above it, the rules in a hairline box, and one button in the reader's accent. Restrained rather than colourful, and it follows each reader's theme and their light or dark mode.
designed-modern.shows: Shown to accounts less than a month old, once.

designed-front-page.label: A designed front page
designed-front-page.description: The same welcome, laid out in the design editor instead of written as prose: a badge, a heading, two link columns, a notice, your house rules in a slot, and one button. Every block on it is one the old Qt clients can draw too.
designed-front-page.shows: Shown to accounts less than a month old, once.

designed-notice.label: A designed notice
designed-notice.description: The short kind of design: a heading, a bordered card, the date it matters by, and a quiet button for the people with accounts. Start here when the front page is more than the occasion needs.
designed-notice.shows: Shown to everyone with an account, once.

front-door.label: A front door
front-door.description: The full welcome screen: a badge, a title, a paragraph, one button that matters, and a row of links. Built from bands, so it is drawn in the client's own type scale rather than as pasted-in HTML.

server-front-page.label: The full front page
server-front-page.description: Everything a welcome screen can be: a painted title bar, the server's own artwork, a centred introduction, a version line, a list of links, the button, and a notice bar at the bottom. Start here and delete what you do not want.

old-and-new.label: One screen for new clients, one for old
old-and-new.description: The same welcome twice: bands for clients that draw them, and the identical bands compiled to Qt tables for Mumble 1.5 and older. Split on client version, so nobody gets the wrong one.
old-and-new.shows: Two rules - clients newer than 1.5.0, and 1.5.0 or older.

newcomer-and-regular.label: Newcomers here, regulars there
newcomer-and-regular.description: Two greetings on one canvas: the long welcome for the first week, the short announcement for everybody else. The shape most servers end up with.
newcomer-and-regular.shows: Two rules - under a week old, and everyone registered.
